`final class NodeCharEvent<N extends Node>`<br/>
**Extends:** [`NodeInputEvent<N>`](/reference/events/nodeinputevent/)<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.ui.event.impl.node` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [NodeCharEvent.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/ui/event/impl/node/NodeCharEvent.java)

The event of `handleCharTyped` on a node, with one typed character as a Unicode code point.

## Description

The character comes with the layout and the Shift key applied; control characters, such as the one of Enter, never arrive.
Every visible node of the UI receives it, whether the pointer is over it or not.

- [Keyboard](/use/learn/interactivity/keyboard/#react-to-a-key)

### create

`<N extends Node> NodeCharEvent<N> create(N node, int codepoint, IConsumableEvent source)` <span class="joid-qualifier">factory</span>

Creates the event for a node and a code point.
`source` is the input that the event belongs to, consumed with it, or `null` for an input of its own.
